name: Alpha-to-Weight Computation (Forward)
definition: Computes ray-space weights and transmittance from per-sample alpha values, handling variable-length rays by segmenting points by ray ID and early-terminating when transmittance drops below a threshold.
summary: Alpha-to-Weight Computation (Forward) converts per-sample opacity values into rendering weights and cumulative transmittance for ray casting, distinct from density-to-alpha conversion as it operates on already-computed alpha values.
